Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production 2D hand-painted dark-fantasy minor-enemy melee VFX sprite atlas, genuine transparent PNG.
Primary request: exactly 28 isolated effect sprites, 4 columns by 7 rows. Each row is one coherent attack with four visibly changing animation phases: column 0 compact anticipation/charge, column 1 forceful release/swing, column 2 local impact/material burst, column 3 dissipating remnants. These effects belong to normal small enemies, not giant bosses. Effects only: NO characters, no enemy bodies, no UI icons, no labels, no text.

Canvas/composition: portrait sheet, preferably 1024 by 1792. Seven evenly spaced horizontal rows, four columns; generous completely transparent gutters. Each sprite fully contained with about24px transparent padding. All directional slashes/stings/hooks face RIGHT, release originates on the LEFT of its sprite and projects right. Anchor/pivot at a consistent local center near each sprite's left-center, same scale and viewpoint within a row. Dissipation is an actual broken-up fading material form, not a copy of release.

ROW 0 scorpion toxic claw and sting: hard chitin-orange curved strike trace, narrow viridian venom point and thick poisonous droplets. Col0 short hooked amber/green streak gathering at sting; col1 longer sharp hooked thrust toward right; col2 chitin splinter and viscous green impact spit; col3 a few separate amber fragments and dim green beads.
ROW 1 spider foreleg and silk: pointed pearl-lavender twin claw slashes linked by fibrous silk strands. Col0 taut short threads bunching; col1 long two-pronged diagonal shear with stretched webs; col2 small tangled torn cobweb with sharp silk fibers; col3 broken thread wisps dispersing. Draw physical fibrous silk, not a simple outlined circle.
ROW 2 bat sonic dive bite: restrained dusty-magenta and violet compressed air blade shaped like a sharp bat-wing sweep with rippling air striations, NO bat body. Col0 compact compressed crescent; col1 fast forward sonic wing slash; col2 crumpled magenta shock shards and narrow air ripples; col3 thin torn mist striations. Avoid concentric full rings.
ROW 3 bull stone hammer impact: heavy earthy gray-brown mineral swing trace with a hornlike carved stone ridge motif, warm ochre grit and angular rock chips. Col0 a few close gritty streaks lifting; col1 weighty downward-right stone-dust arc; col2 low shattered stone impact and angular chips erupting up, no ground tile; col3 settling dust fragments. This is a rock hammer attack, not a bull character or a new charging beast.
ROW 4 mantis twin scythes: two distinct narrow jade-green cutting crescents with dark chitin edge and fine leaflike serration. Col0 short overlapping edge glints; col1 long crossing hooked twin cuts to right; col2 intersecting sharp green material sparks; col3 thin fading broken jade shavings. Not a generic thick glow swoosh.
ROW 5 skeleton shield and short sword: aged ivory bone flecks, cool blue-gray steel edge and muted grave dust. Col0 compact shield-edge glint with bone fragments; col1 broad angular steel-and-bone bash/slash sweep right; col2 brittle ivory chips and pale spectral impact streaks; col3 low grave-dust wisps and few chips. No skull-faced character, no shield prop icon.
ROW 6 lizard chain hook-axe: oxidized blue-gray iron chain links and a dark hooked cutting trace. Col0 tightly coiling short chain with cold edge glint; col1 extended curved chain with distinct hooked end pointing RIGHT; col2 hook catches and chain forms a sharp tense zigzag with metal sparks; col3 chain recoil curl and a few dim iron sparks. Visible actual interlocked metal links, not a simple glowing line. No hand or character.

Style: refined painterly raster game VFX, tactile material mass with controlled translucent edges, original dark fantasy. Broad readable silhouettes for small display sizes; restrained center brightness, preserve color/material detail, no huge white cores. Rich but concise texture, no flat vector art, no simple circles as final effect. Slightly muted palettes coordinated with ironwood, chitin, antique metal and gothic fantasy.
Background: truly transparent alpha, all empty areas fully clear. NO black/colored background, NO tile backgrounds, NO backdrop gradients, no baked checkerboard, NO glow fog spanning sprites. No oversized full-screen explosions.
Constraints: exactly seven rows in the stated order and exactly four phases per row. No touching adjacent assets, no clipped particles. Do not repeat the same picture with only opacity changes; show real evolving geometry and material motion.
